description: Elections Commission - B. S. R. Kumara of the Madurawala Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna - K. K. J. K. Perera of the Dodangoda Pradeshiya Sabha has vacated his office of member of the Sri Lanka Podujana Peramuna
reasoning: This gazette content contains notices under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, specifically declaring that members of Pradeshiya Sabhas (local government bodies) have vacated their offices due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and related matters, specifically addressing the vacation of office by elected members, which is covered by Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
